Hi
Hello there! Welcome to Ting-A-Ling Schools. How can I help you today? 😊
I would like to know what the school hours are ?
Great question! The hours do differ slightly between our two schools. Are you asking about the **Pre-Primary School** or the **Special Needs School**? 😊
Special needs school
The Special Needs School operates from **07:00 to 13:00** on school days. For those who need it, aftercare is available until **17:00** 😊
Thank you very much
You're most welcome! If you have any other questions about enrolments, fees, or anything else, feel free to ask. 😊
Hi
Hello and welcome to Ting-A-Ling Schools! How can I help you today? 😊
I would like to know about the tracksuits please

Our tracksuits are R450 each and are part of the school uniform. Uniforms are available during purchase windows that will be announced by the school, and the full list and pricelist is also available from the office if you need more details. 😊
Okay thank you very much
You're most welcome! If you ever need anything else, feel free to reach out — the office is always happy to help at info@tingalingschools.com or 0615274429 / 0724561282. 😊
Hi
Hi there! Welcome to Ting-A-Ling Schools. How can I help you today?
What ages do Ting-A-Ling start from?

Great question! We have two schools, so it depends which one you're asking about:

- **Pre-Primary School** takes children from **2 to 6 years old**
- **Special Needs School** takes children from **3 to 12 years old**

Which one were you interested in? 😊
Pre-Primary School

Our Pre-Primary School welcomes children from **2 to 6 years old**. We use a play-based learning approach with English integrated into the daily programme, and we offer half-day options as well. You can find us at 74 Krewilkring, Meerensee — feel free to pop in for a tour! 🙂

Hy, 
How can i get enrollment form?

You're welcome to get an enrolment form online through the Ting-A-Ling Schools website parent portal, or you can pop into the school office for a registration pack. Feel free to call or email if you'd like more info first — info@tingalingschools.com, 0615274429 / 0724561282.
Morning teacher
Morning! 😊 What can I help you with today?
